Santosh Kumar Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 8 September, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81354594/
1

 Court No. - 13
 Hon'Ble Subhash Vidyarthi, J. 
1.

Heard Shri Chandra Bhushan, learned counsel for the applicant, Smt. Kamlesh Kumari, learned
A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime
No.529 of 2018 under Sections 409/419/420/467/468/471 of I.P.C. registered at Police Station-
Raniganj, District- Pratapgarh.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 31.12.2018 against five
persons, including the applicant, stating that an inspection was conducted regarding latrines
constructed under Mgnrega Scheme whereupon it was found that Rs.7,56,000/- were paid to M/s
Laxmi and Traders without supply of any material for constructing 72 latrines.

4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is
working as a Computer Operator and he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has
no criminal history.

5. Learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application and she has
submitted that allegations have been established during investigation and a charge-sheet has been
submitted on25.07.2025.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact
that the applicant, being a computer operator, had no authority to sanction the payment and that he
has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 23.07.2025 whereas the investigation
stands concluded, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for
enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid case.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
-Amit K- Santosh Kumar Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
